description.value: Carbone is an Italian-American restaurant located on historic Thompson Street in Greenwich Village. Wikipedia places the original at 181 Thompson Street. Its official site describes captains sporting tuxedos by Zac Posen, and reservations are famously hard to get, so book well ahead.
